bullets.bullet_text: Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital modeling engagements, applying exotic pricing, liability Greeks, and higher-order stress testing to design robust hedge structures for regulated clients.

Directed CCAR-era capital, liquidity, and stress-testing programs, structuring traceable scenarios and challenger models while driving model-risk remediation and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
Architected enterprise risk-management operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation frameworks, defining three-lines-of-defense accountability and auditable risk metrics.
